messages:
eli: Nightly model-pruner job (03:00 UTC) partially failed on shard-pruner-7 — it cleaned ~60% of expired checkpoints, left ~40% with EACCES on delete. CI shows 'pruner: cleanup failed (perm denied)'. Can someone rerun a full sweep and/or bisect? /cc @sara

sara: Saw that too. Quick look shows NFS flakiness on node-7. Log snippet shows `rm /mnt/checkpoints/...: permission denied`. Might be kubelet/mount race. I'll try a rerun targeting node-selector=node-8 to avoid node-7 for now.

kevin: I'll kick off a bisect in parallel — my guess is the k8s/kubelet upgrade we rolled last week. Which rollout touched prod nodes around 02:30-03:00? @anya?

anya: That was k8s-upgrade-2026-03-15 (sha: 9a7c). infra-bot recorded cordon/drain for node-7 at 02:45 UTC.

eli: Minimal error context from the pruner pod logs:
```
ERROR pruner: delete /mnt/ckpt/model-2026-03-14-xyz failed: unlink /mnt/ckpt/model-2026-03-14-xyz: permission denied (os error 13)
stack: runtime.go:...
```

sara: Rerun scheduled: `./scripts/pruner/run-nightly --shards all --force-rerun` — I triggered it with node-avoid=node-7. ci-bot: can you attach the job id?

ci-bot: pruner-nightly job started (job id: pruner-nightly-1745012). Watching logs at https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/pruner-nightly-1745012

kevin: Bisect started: testing kubelet changes around 9a7c -> rolling a small canary cluster with kubelet@9a7c-revert to confirm. Will report back in ~30-45m.

infra-bot: Node-7 mount logs show intermittent ENOENT then EACCES for the same path within ~2m window. Suggest remount and check gid/uid map. Filed INF-317 to track node remediation.

anya: I'll watch the rerun and prepare a small runtime patch: make pruner tolerate EACCES by backing off and retrying a couple times before failing. If rerun still fails, we can merge as emergency.

sara: Rerun finished: cleaned all shards except one file flagged immutable on node-7. Manual remount + `chattr -i` then delete cleared it. Outcome: partial success, most space reclaimed. We'll roll forward but we should avoid immediate compacting until INF-317 resolved.

eli: Thanks all. I'll open a PR adding exponential backoff + one-migration retry to the pruner logic and link the infra ticket. Assigning @anya for review.

kevin: Will update with bisect results — initial signals point to kubelet change affecting mount permission caching. If confirmed, we'll coordinate a rollback.

sara: Nice work. Leaving a quick follow-up doc in the runbook: add 'if EACCES on delete -> remount candidate node, retry pruner'.

eli: Great, closing the loop here. If anything else pops up, ping this thread. :thumbsup:
